suggestions.title: Move fast-changing tool lists and policy timelines into dated reference pages
suggestions.why: Repeated refreshes find that vendor maps, product picks and policy news age much faster than the underlying teaching. Keep the durable methods in lessons and move volatile material into linked, dated references, sharing the model list between M1 L04 and L05.

suggestions.title: Widen syllabus project briefs to match the work learners actually do
suggestions.why: Repeated notes find syllabus briefs, project titles and lesson summaries promising different tasks or outcomes from the projects supplied. Align each affected lesson around one project brief, with matching scope, title and realistic time, rather than adding exercises to satisfy obsolete descriptions.

suggestions.title: Widen security foundations into a shared builder governance module
suggestions.why: The notes repeatedly flag gaps around automated decisions, EU-facing services and agent security, while coding lessons repeat growing compliance briefings. Give the essentials one home in M2 L06, with advanced practice in L29 and clear pointers from the coding lessons and capstone.

suggestions.title: Widen database foundations to match the shared Month 2 app build
suggestions.why: The Supabase title conflicts with a Neon and Better Auth build, and later lessons disagree about the database and retrieval stack. Make L08 a technology-neutral app-backbone lesson, choose one working build route and carry it consistently through research, AskMyCo and dashboards.

suggestions.title: Move advanced builder and workplace exercises from Month 1 into Month 2
suggestions.why: Month 1 includes coding-agent installation, team automation, MCP building and licensed workplace practice that overlap the Month 2 builder route. Move coding setup and test drives into the Month 2 coding lessons, team tasks into L15 and advanced agent labs into optional practice, keeping simple introductions in Month 1.

suggestions.title: Widen app testing to include AI output evaluation before advanced evals
suggestions.why: Testing needs to build on the GitHub Actions check introduced in L04 and teach beginners how to judge variable AI answers, while automation has accumulated advanced simulated-user testing. Add a small review of real outputs in L09 and move simulated-user evaluation from L15 to L28.

suggestions.title: Merge repeated paid-model comparisons into the Month 2 AI Garage
suggestions.why: The renamed Month 1 and Month 2 Garage lessons still carry their older efficiency and coding-stack material, while Month 3 repeats premium-model comparisons. Keep free and low-cost testing in Month 1, consolidate paid-model value and routine efficiency in Month 2, and retain only distinct workplace strategy in Month 3.

suggestions.title: Move website and visual launch-kit projects into the existing media lessons
suggestions.why: M1 L09 has a public-website project attached to mostly private-build teaching, and L07 promises visual follow-on work without an assigned home. Put website publishing in L16 and visual launch-kit work in L27, leaving L09 with a private-assistant build and L07 focused on writing.

suggestions.title: Widen saved-assistant teaching beyond custom GPTs
suggestions.why: The notes flag changing access to custom GPTs and Gems, putting exercises tied to one saved-assistant format at risk. Teach a portable route using saved instructions, skills or plugins in L18 and make the Month 1 review accept equivalent working assistants.

suggestions.title: Move the Month 1 portfolio and review to the end of the learning route
suggestions.why: The Month 1 portfolio and review precede later lessons, including the core OpenAI lesson, and an earlier note already found that the recap did not match the month. Put the portfolio immediately before the final review and make clear which optional lessons contribute.

suggestions.title: Widen FamilyBot sharing to cover connectors and consent
suggestions.why: The FamilyBot arc stops at prompts and uploaded files, while the notes identify connected mail, calendars and documents as a missing next step. Keep files as the starting point and add an optional L24 connector exercise covering consent, permissions and approval before writing.

suggestions.title: Widen RAG foundations to start with managed and agentic document search
suggestions.why: The research notes question whether a hand-built chunk-and-embed pipeline should remain the first route for beginners. Compare managed file search and agentic document search in L10, then teach embeddings and custom retrieval as deliberate choices that lead into AskMyCo and advanced RAG.

suggestions.title: Widen the Month 2 capstone with a sector-adaptation brief
suggestions.why: The portfolio expects an industry-specific build that the capstone never explicitly assigns. Add a clear option to adapt AskMyCo or FractionalBuddy using an existing sector lesson, so the portfolio can assess work learners were actually asked to do.

suggestions.title: Widen the travel lesson to include personal and group trips
suggestions.why: The syllabus promises a group event planner, but the lesson and project mainly serve a travel-business owner. Offer personal or group planning alongside the business route, with a matching project brief for each audience.

suggestions.title: Move LinkedIn rewriting into the CV and LinkedIn lesson
suggestions.why: LinkedIn rewriting in the job-search lesson duplicates the CV and LinkedIn lesson. Keep profile and friend-rewrite exercises in L14 so L15 can concentrate on finding roles and preparing for interviews.

suggestions.title: Move the AI landscape lesson before the frontier-labs comparison
suggestions.why: The notes place the landscape lesson after L11 even though L03 leads into it and it introduces L05. Move it before L05 so beginners meet the map before comparing suppliers.

suggestions.title: Widen core agent safety to introduce agents without optional prerequisites
suggestions.why: Core agent safety relies on an explanation of agents taught only in optional automation and agents lessons. Add the minimum agent introduction to L13 so every learner can complete the safety lesson independently.

suggestions.title: Merge repeated prompting and checking instructions into shared Month 1 guidance
suggestions.why: Goal-first briefs and whole-document habits are retaught across seven lessons, while most Month 1 projects repeat the two-chat critique method. Teach each method fully in one place and link back from later applications, retaining task-specific safety instructions.

suggestions.title: Merge repeated transcription setup into one reusable introduction
suggestions.why: Handy and Buzz setup is repeated in the taster, transcription lesson and FamilyBot Listens. Keep the minimum voice setup in L00, put the full setup in L28 and let FamilyBot reuse it for its household task.

suggestions.title: Widen project guidance to explain assessment consistently across the course
suggestions.why: Only three capstone endpoints currently explain how projects are marked, while the notes flag inconsistent points and marking elsewhere. Explain assessment at the start of each project arc and carry the same criteria and points through its project, portfolio and review guidance.

suggestions.title: Split overloaded Month 1 lessons into shorter, focused sessions
suggestions.why: Several introductory lessons now run well beyond their intended sitting as extra topics and exercises accumulate. Give basic safety its own early session, place specialist rights, accessibility, complaints and bookkeeping work in focused follow-ons, and move extra taster exercises and project alternatives into later practice.

suggestions.title: Widen the frontier-labs comparison beyond three companies
suggestions.why: The research notes question a comparison limited to OpenAI, Anthropic and Google when learners also encounter xAI and open-weight models from other suppliers. Widen the comparison to cover those choices and model provenance without adding another introductory vendor-tour lesson.

suggestions.title: Split coding workflows by solo work and team delivery
suggestions.why: The current boundary between one-machine practice and remote or parallel work is weakening as those features appear in ordinary coding tools. Recut L22 and L23 around careful solo work versus team workflows and automated delivery, using L21 as a tool-specific companion.

suggestions.title: Split search visibility from agent shopping
suggestions.why: GEO auditing and website trust form a relatively stable lesson, while agent checkout, payments and commercial responsibilities have become a separate fast-moving subject. Split L16 into search visibility and agent shopping so each has a clear project and maintenance cycle.

suggestions.title: Split design foundations from AI design tools
suggestions.why: L25 now combines design systems, accessibility, a tool survey, Claude Design and Impeccable in one long sitting. Separate reusable design and accessibility foundations from the practical AI design-tool workshop.

suggestions.title: Split performers' voice and likeness rights from training-data copyright
suggestions.why: The creative-industries lesson combines training-data copyright with rights over a performer's voice and likeness, which the notes identify as a growing topic of its own. Give performers a focused follow-on if the policy work produces enough practical material to justify another session.

suggestions.title: Widen the finance lesson to cover everyday chatbot money questions
suggestions.why: The finance lesson focuses on builders and regulated services, leaving out ordinary learners asking general chatbots about pensions or other money decisions. Add a consumer route that teaches boundaries, checking and where to seek appropriate help alongside the builder route.

suggestions.title: Merge repeated hosting and open-model introductions across Months 2 and 3
suggestions.why: The course notes flag overlapping self-hosting and open-model lessons in Months 2 and 3. Keep practical setup and model trials in Month 2, and retain Month 3 sessions only for distinct enterprise operation and leadership decisions.

suggestions.title: Split sector teaching between building in Month 2 and leading in Month 3
suggestions.why: Healthcare, legal and finance topics recur across Months 2 and 3 without a clear difference in purpose in the course notes. Give Month 2 the practical build exercises and Month 3 the organisational adoption, assurance and accountability work, linking back to shared foundations.

suggestions.title: Merge repeated board-briefing teaching into the core AI champion lesson
suggestions.why: Board briefing appears in both the core AI champion playbook and an optional dedicated lesson. Consolidate the shared briefing method and exercise in L19, retaining L22 only if it offers distinct advanced practice.
